## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C IPO and TRA execution

- 2013-04-08: Form-of TRA filed as Exhibit 10.8 to S-1/A Amendment No. 3
- 2013-07-23: IPO closed; TRA executed between UCP, Inc., UCP, LLC, and PICO Holdings
- 2013-08 (Q2 2013 10-Q): Executed TRA filed as Exhibit 10.8

#### Century Communities merger and TRA termination

- 2017-04-10: Voting Support and Transfer Restriction Agreement signed; UCP, UCP LLC, and PICO covenanted to terminate the TRA effective at the merger Effective Time
- 2017-08-04: Century Communities / Casa Acquisition Corp. merger closed; TRA terminated at the Effective Time; no separate consideration paid to PICO for the termination

## Explanation

UCP, Inc. executed this TRA on July 23, 2013 at the closing of its Up-C IPO, agreeing to pay 85% of net cash tax savings from Section 754 basis step-ups generated by future exchanges of UCP, LLC Series A Units held by PICO Holdings, Inc. (the sole TRA beneficiary, who was also UCP's pre-IPO majority holder). PICO never exchanged any Series A Units, so Cumulative Net Realized Tax Benefit was zero throughout the TRA's life and no liability was ever recorded on UCP's balance sheet. When Century Communities, Inc. agreed to acquire UCP in April 2017, the parties built a TRA termination covenant into the Voting Support and Transfer Restriction Agreement, conditional on closing; the merger closed August 4, 2017 and the TRA was terminated at the Effective Time with no separate payment to PICO (consistent with the Article 4 formula producing no Early Termination Payment under zero realized benefits). See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
